title: Seacrest Beach "Blue Oasis" 48 Cottage Way Unit 4
h1: Seacrest Beach "Blue Oasis" 48 Cottage Way Unit 4
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Panoramic Gulf views- Walking distance to the beach- Private deeded beach access- Community pool and hot tub- Ideally situated between Alys Beach and Seaside- 5 adult bikes- Outdoor shower- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Relaxation awaits at Blue Oasis! Nestled in Seacrest Beach, this 3-level Emerald Coast retreat is perfect for groups and large families, sleeping up to 10 guests with 5 beautiful bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and access to a community pool and sitting spa. Savor the Gulf view over a cup of coffee before heading out to unwind on the sugar-soft, white sand beach—only a short stroll away!Designed for easy beach days, this retreat welcomes guests with a wooden boardwalk and an outdoor shower for rinsing off after a trip to the shore. Step inside to find a light-filled foyer with plenty of room to store sandals and beach bags, while the laundry nook off the hall adds convenience throughout every stay. There are 2 inviting guest bedrooms on this level, each featuring a king bed and private bathroom for comfy sleeping accommodations. Discover Gulf views, coastal blues, and a shiplap feature wall in the combined living, dining, and kitchen space on the second level. The plush wraparound sofa and elegant armchairs, all set before a fireplace and TV, beckon guests for cozy nights of entertainment. Steps away, indulge in delicious dinner parties beside the view at the 8-person dining table. Extra seating for 4 is available at the breakfast bar off the fully equipped kitchen, which features high-end appliances and granite countertops. Out the glass doors, drink in the Gulf views from the covered balcony. Retire to the guest bedroom with 2 soft queen beds and a private bathroom.On the third level, a lovely primary bedroom boasting a king bed and private bathroom offers a peaceful oasis, complete with a furnished Gulf-view balcony. Guests young in heart and age will enjoy the bunk room’s twin-over-full bed and balcony overlooking the neighborhood.With gorgeous views and enticing community amenities, Blue Oasis offers an excellent Seacrest Beach getaway. On-site parking makes it easy to visit nearby Alys Beach and Seaside—or hop on the 5 complimentary adult bikes to explore at a leisurely pace. For beach access, turn left onto 30A and follow the Timpoochee Trail. The gate to the beach is located between 2 homes on the 8800 block. Book today!
